generic_semantic_candidate.name: statused_large_cell_deferral_stream
generic_semantic_candidate.description: A traversal-stage stream of deferred large-cell hits emitted under a generic payload status machine: active query id, cell id, current-best state, prune/abort/completed/miss status, and optional post-stream grouped continuation.
why_generic: It describes a backend traversal/control-flow pattern rather than X-HD, Figure 7, or author option names.
The same shape applies to any spatial nearest/coverage pipeline that defers oversized cells from traversal to a continuation pass.
It can be validated by synthetic app-neutral fixtures before using X-HD author traces.

author_source_semantics_observed.raw_stream_stage: OptiX shader appends offloading_point_ids/offloading_cell_ids before loadBalanceProcessing sort/reduce.
author_source_semantics_observed.large_cell_append_condition: A cell is appended when it survives prune/current-best checks and its point count is greater than processing_threshold.
author_source_semantics_observed.post_stream_continuation: loadBalanceProcessing groups offload rows by active query, restores cmin2, scans deferred cells, and may update global cmax2.
author_source_semantics_observed.why_full_cover_is_not_equivalent: RTDL full-cover is a deterministic geometric surface; author raw offload is a traversal-status stream affected by prune/current-best/abort/offload payload state and traversal-hit semantics.

goal5410_required_gates.description: A non-X-HD fixture must prove the statused deferral stream contract without paper names, author constants, or X-HD option semantics.
A bounded X-HD trace must recover sampled author rows by semantics, not by hard-coded cell ids or row counts.
A full-public gate must compare row count, row hash, sampled point/cell ids, status counts, feedback count, and cmin2 hashes against Goal5387.
If the candidate requires X-HD-only constants or cannot recover row identity, explicit -lb remains unsupported and the status stream line stops.

forbidden_shortcuts: add X-HD option names to RTDL core/native
claim explicit -lb support before full row-count/hash/sample/status parity
claim Figure 7 or Figure 11 reproduction from a semantic probe
